name: Crowd-Pleasers (last 10 years)
source: TMDB /discover/movie — highly rated, with a vote-count floor
note: A query-backed list: membership is re-derived from TMDB rather than fixed, so it stays current without re-seeding. The vote_count floor of 5000 is the whole point — /movie/top_rated has no such floor, which is why it mixes genuine classics with obscure titles a handful of enthusiastic fans have pushed to the top. Measured at 1000 it still returned Gabriel's Inferno; at 5000 it returns Top Gun: Maverick, Across the Spider-Verse and The Wild Robot. Exists to balance a library that is otherwise heavily arthouse-canon weighted.
